additional_dependencies_read: prisma/schema.prisma selected eight root tables plus schedule/template/timeline/snapshot dependencies
accepted_contracts: Eight root families independently enumerated by tenant; no temporal filter or dependency inner join can silently omit orphan roots. Exact SQL C-collated comparison/order, 128-row pages, full/empty-page completion and cumulative count/byte guards retain complete visible cross-page dependencies before kernel evaluation.

All approval revisions are available together. Shared strict audit validator extraction preserves prior window behavior while the sweep uses its separate 1000-root coverage. Missing/cross-scope/malformed audit references refuse; differing syntactically valid hashes reach kernel mismatch.

Linked schedule subjects resolve exact tenant/workday/agent/date joins to pinned schedule/shift/policy snapshots, canonical payload hash and selected segment membership; mutable assignment selection does not replace pinned history.

Schedule-only subjects require first-segment/start agreement, immutable template definition/hash/activation/team scope and bounded effective assignment/team/org/default selection. Auxiliary template/team text is length-bounded in SQL before transfer. This is visible-timeline consistency only.

Caller owns authorized read-only transaction. Sweep observes copied cursor state before reading, uses RepeatableRead with five-second statement and thirty-second interactive-transaction limits, awaits successful transaction finalization, then calls existing lease/version cursor fence. Mismatch/error/overflow/unknown prior protocol cannot advance progress.

Opaque wf-sweep-v1 random UUID progress is not a row cursor or tenant-coverage token. Full restart sees lower-key/backdated/updated rows on later invocations. Unknown checkpoint acknowledgement is surfaced and safely replayable.
No business writes, runtime endpoint, scheduler registration, new credentials, grants or schema changes. Source search found no runtime consumers outside new helper composition/tests.
